thread:
Priya: Hey all — quick question. I have an IC who plans to switch from fully remote (Portugal) to a hybrid setup with a US homebase (packing up in June, moving mid-July). How do we handle WFH stipend proration and whether this triggers any tax nexus concerns? TL;DR: move date 2026-07-15, new homebase CA.

Liam: fyi this is me — does the stipend stop when they leave Portugal or when payroll address changes?

Erin: Hi @Liam — good q. Policy-wise we prorate the monthly WFH allowance based on homebase change month. So if move happens mid-July, July gets pro-rated. We need the formal homebase change submitted in Ripcord (HR portal) before payroll cutoff for July to reflect the proration correctly.

Liam: cool — payroll cutoff = which date?

Erin: payroll cutoff is the 20th for the following month's payroll config. So to affect July proration you'd want the change in by 2026-07-20. If submitted after, it will apply to August and we'd manually adjust July stipend.

Kelly: Also note — moving from Portugal -> CA could affect local benefits enrollment windows and tax withholding. Finance will need the effective date to calculate any retro tax withholding if necessary.

Liam: got it. who should I loop in for tax questions?

Priya: tagging @tax-bot to get an automated check on nexus and any country-to-state flags. Also @Kelly for payroll adjustments.

tax-bot: Automated check complete — possible state tax nexus flagged for California. Action items:
1) Verify start date and whether employee will be an expat/contractor conversion.
2) Confirm payroll address change in Ripcord.
3) If more than 30 days in CA in a calendar year, payroll may need state withholding.
4) Recommend People Ops + Finance sync for final withholding and off-cycle adjustment.

Liam: thanks. One more practical — do they need to return equipment or will that move with them?

Erin: If they're on company laptop, they can keep it. Please file a relocation ticket in Ops with shipping details if they need a new monitor or desk stipend on arrival.

Priya: Next steps for me: 1) confirm exact move date with the employee, 2) ask them to submit homebase change in Ripcord ASAP, 3) cc @Kelly for payroll, 4) schedule a 1:1 People Ops x Finance quick sync if tax-bot flags anything more complex.

Liam: I'll ping them now. thanks team :pray:

Priya: Thanks! I'll follow up once payroll confirms proration amount. (Ref: policy code `HR-LOC-CHANGE` and WFH matrix on the handbook: https://intranet.redwood/work-from-anywhere)
